description: Create a Brevo contact attribute (POST /contacts/attributes/{category}/{name}). Required: category (normal|transactional|category|calculated|global), name (UPPER_CASE). Optional: type (text|date|float|boolean|id|category), enumeration, value.

category.description: Attribute category in Brevo; determines how the attribute is stored and used

enumeration.description: Selectable values for an attribute of type category

value.description: Value or formula for calculated and global attributes

name: create_brevo_attribute
